facts.fact: The Authority published guidelines on personal data breach notifications under sections 36 and 37 of the Act (72-hour notice to the Authority and to data subjects, record keeping); the document reports no decision or sanction.

The guidelines state that the Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority is the designated Data Protection Authority, mandated by the Data Protection Act (No. 3 of 2024) to oversee its implementation, and it is issuing guidance as such.
